commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' 1 - 0 GOAL! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) latches onto a cross and sends the ball into the top left corner with a powerful header!
90+4' The ball is out of play. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

84' Here comes a substitution. Tom Louchet is given a rest as he is replaced by Salis Abdul Samed (Nice).

82' Jeremie Boga (Nice) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.

65' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Joao Neves is replaced by Fabian Ruiz (PSG).

60' Bradley Barcola smashes in a cross, but Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) finds it almost impossible to control and sends his header high over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
58' Senny Mayulu (PSG) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
56' One of the players from Nice times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
55' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

54' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Corner kick. PSG will have an opportunity.
53' Joao Neves (PSG) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
51' Vitinha (PSG) sends an accurate pass to Nuno Mendes, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
50' The referee points to the corner flag and PSG will take a corner.
47' PSG are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Isak Jansson comes off for Sofiane Diop (Nice).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' PSG are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
43' PSG are seeing far more of the ball now.

38' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the right side of the goal, but it lacks power and Yehvann Diouf pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
36' Vitinha (PSG) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
33' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
32' The referee blows his whistle, Nice are awarded a corner kick.
31' Morgan Sanson (Nice) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
30' Nice control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
30' Ball possession – 83:17.
28' What was Juma Bah (Nice) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
27' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' The game is interrupted now, Kojo Peprah (Nice) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
19' Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul after Nuno Mendes (PSG) hacks down one of his opponents.

14' Bradley Barcola (PSG) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
13' PSG hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Vitinha (PSG) and Nuno Mendes perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
10' The corner from Nuno Mendes (PSG) is intercepted by Yehvann Diouf.
7' PSG hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
6' Nuno Mendes (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
5' Nuno Mendes (PSG) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
4' Nuno Mendes (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' Vitinha (PSG) sends an accurate short pass. Nuno Mendes controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
